qa_pair.question: During the 2025 trip to Japan the household took a cooking class, and the dish they made there was later saved as a recipe in the vault. At what oven temperature, in degrees Celsius, is that dish baked? Answer with the number only.
In the garden notes, one raised bed was cleared when its garlic was harvested. Which crop was planted in that same bed afterwards? Answer with the crop name in lowercase.
The vault keeps book reviews under a dedicated tag. How many of the reviewed books received the top rating of 5/5? Answer with a number.
Of the work projects tracked in the vault, which one has the earliest deadline? Answer with the project note's title.
A journal entry mentions a novel lent by a neighbour. What is the surname of the novel's author, according to the vault's notes on it? Answer with the surname only.
Where did the household stay on the final night of the Japan trip before flying home? Answer with the hotel name exactly as written in the vault.

One note is displayed with the title "Seed starting calendar" although its file has a different name. In which folder is it stored? Answer with the folder path relative to the vault root, using / as the separator.
Among the recipes marked as vegetarian, which one has the longest total time as stated in the recipe, not counting any resting time? Answer with the recipe's title.
How many notes are stored in the folder for the 2025 trip to Japan (directly in that folder)? Answer with a number.
For the work project that builds a customer analytics dashboard, the kickoff meeting chose a database for the event tables. Which database was chosen? Answer with its name only.
